title: Frosty source and Analyzer comparison for spotting inputs
scope: 1.4.3.0 multiplayer weapon spotting bases and mapped muzzle/barrel/ammo choices; KSG retained as a separate single-player-only WB reference, not included among the 63 site weapons.

build.identityRule: Authoritative roster roots[].internalId -> siteIdentity; all 63 site identities resolve exactly; KSG siteIdentity is null.

siteModel.formula: world = 54 × muzzle × barrel × ammo worldSpotMult; minimap = 150 × muzzle × barrel × ammo minimapSpotMult, rounded to 6 decimals.
siteModel.execution: site-spotting-runtime.mjs calls resetAttsForWeapon then applyAttachments for defaults and each mapped selection.

weaponBases.sourceFieldPath: WB Class_542ac52c/Field_5ebda408: Field_9918e670 candidate world; Field_31022dc5 candidate minimap.
weaponBases.rawVerification: All 64 WBs were byte checked in spotting-base-range-trace; each per-record source hash, byte sequence and offset is retained.

attachmentSelections.identitySelectorAndPerWeaponWBImport: All 1,214 choices are source-linked by the exact mapping; each selector is joined to its WPM wrapper and to that site weapon WB import.
attachmentSelections.withoutEffectSiteFactors: Every no-direct-effect choice has site spotting factors 1/1. Source absence does not prove no other native effect.

effectComparison.composition: Separate 2D and 3D factors were multiplied by channel for numeric comparison only; native composition remains unproved.

rawEvidence.rehash: All 28 spotting-relevant WPM/WME bodies visited in the broader scan were rehashed against current captured raw files. Six unique WME objects have 18 descriptor-derived exact field-offset proofs for the three numeric spotting operands. Whole-body byte occurrence searches are discovery only, not field proof.

blockersAndNextEvidence.runtime: Serialized imports and operands do not establish execution, priority winner, activation, or effective result.
blockersAndNextEvidence.gameplayTest: A controlled enemy observer can distinguish 15 m from 21 m minimap spotting for the four SP candidate choices; M45A1/vz61 can be tested against 27/64.29 versus 54/150 m base cutoffs. Fix LOS, mode, observer, movement, and build; repeat trials.
blockersAndNextEvidence.remaining: Mapped muzzle/barrel/ammo bindings are complete for exact selector-to-WB-import source presence. Native semantics and any other source families are unresolved.

reproduction.rawJoinDetails: The attachment-factor report contains every site choice and exact source chain. Field-level JSONL includes parent selection, WB route/capture/hash/import pointer, WPM/WME route/capture/hash/object/decoded field path. The six WME objects now have descriptor-derived exact raw offsets/bytes for all three numeric fields; whole-body byte occurrence search is discovery only.

limits: WB base field meanings are candidate assignments supported by value grouping and modifier families.
Source presence and numeric agreement do not prove runtime source execution.
Factor mismatches are exact source/site model candidates, not verified in-game discrepancies.
